jobs.title: Earth Without Humans
jobs.description:
What happens if every human vanished right now? The lights go out in hours, subways flood in 2 days, and wild animals take over the streets. In 10,000 years, almost every city is gone - but our footprints on the Moon could last millions of years.

#earth #whatif #science #space #shorts
